verdict.rationale: Adyen documents refunds through all three requested channels: the Terminal API can issue refunds at the point of sale, refunds can be issued from the Customer Area dashboard, and referenced and unreferenced refund types are documented. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms partial-amount refunds against the original transaction, nor states that referenced refunds return funds to the original card. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of partial refunds on referenced transactions, explicit confirmation that refunds return to the original card, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds back to the original card from the point of sale, dashboard, or API

citations.quote: The Adyen Terminal API lets you make payments, issue refunds, collect shopper information, and perform other shopper-terminal interactions using a payment terminal supplied by Adyen.
We offer two refund types: Referenced refund... Unreferenced refund...
You can also issue refunds from your Customer Area
Unreferenced refunds let you return any amount to any card presented to the terminal.
